name_reason: Already conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately reflects behavior (counts the active/usable inventory slots of a runtime character). No Ghidra address residue. Descriptor 'usable_inventory_slots' matches the body (8 slots, flag bit 0x80 clear => usable).
purpose: Return how many of a runtime character's 8 inventory slots are currently active/usable (flag byte bit 0x80 clear).
logic_summary: Loops slot_iter 0..7 over data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[char_idx]; each slot is 2 bytes (flag at index slot*2, item_id at slot*2+1). A slot counts as usable when its flag byte AND 0x80 == 0. Accumulates the count and returns it. The leading __CHK(8,...) is a compiler-injected stack probe, not source logic.

params.name: ci
params.semantics: Index into the runtime character array (data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr); selects whose inventory is counted. Callers (item/buy/give/equip dispatch, AI, chapter events, slot search) all pass a character index.
params.reason: 'ci' is a terse non-descriptive abbreviation; the plate comment itself names it char_idx, and the four sibling functions in the same file (fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in, fd2_open_char_status_screen, fd2_item_command_menu_dispatch, fd2_equip_unequip_inventory_menu) all use char_idx for the same value. Renaming aligns with the file convention. (Recorded only; applied in Stage 2.)

returns.semantics: Number of usable inventory slots (0..8). Callers treat 0 as 'character has no items' (e.g. item_command/buy/give dispatch return -1 / skip the menu).

notes: Source comment (status.c 105-119) and Ghidra plate are both accurate and mutually consistent (8 slots, flag bit 0x80 clear, caller list, __CHK(8) prologue note); neither edited. Only change is the recorded param rename ci->char_idx (Stage 2). Decompiled struct-field access (pInventory_slots[i].bSlot_flag) maps to src inventory_slots[slot*2] (2-byte slot stride) -- equivalent, no logic concern.
